purpose: Evaluate the existing quiet-input guard and raw sustain-error estimator without tuning on this evaluation set.
policy: Frozen baseline versus FRETWORK_RILEY_LEVEL_GUARD=1; neither condition labels nor human truth may select inference parameters.
release_policy: Coverage is not quality approval. Report paired source-grouped results and human sustain false warnings, misses and coverage. Do not promote defaults automatically.
limitations: Held out from this project's tuning only; Riley training-set overlap cannot be independently guaranteed. Gain variants of one performance count as one source. Simulated room responses do not count as real wet captures.

decision_rules.rule: Targets are preregistered review criteria, not measured achievements or automatic merge approval. Report source-grouped uncertainty and unmatched coverage; insufficient precision or coverage remains blocked.
